title: Elicitation of the parameters of a multi-criteria sorting model
abstract: arXiv:2611.13062v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multiple-criteria decision aiding (MCDA) proposes models and methods for different types of decision problems such as choice, ranking or sorting. Such models involve various parameters that must be elicited. In the elicitation process, all necessary information has to be taken from the decision-maker. For this, several direct and indirect elicitation methods are suggested in the literature. In this work, we concentrate on direct elicitation: we aim at providing a rigorous elicitation procedure for the parameters of the Non-Compensatory Sorting model (NCS), which has been characterized by an axiomatic analysis. A basic version of the NCS model is considered, i.e., a model with two categories and no vetoes. The parameters are the set of sufficient coalitions of criteria and the profile separating the two categories. translated_title: 多准则排序模型参数的引出方法
translated_abstract: 多准则决策辅助（MCDA）为选择、排序或分类等不同类型的决策问题提供了模型和方法。这些模型涉及各种需要被引出的参数。在引出过程中，所有必要的信息都必须从决策者处获取。为此，文献中提出了多种直接和间接的引出方法。在这项工作中，我们专注于直接引出：我们的目标是为非补偿性分类模型（NCS）的参数提供一个严格的引出程序，该模型已通过公理化分析得到刻画。我们考虑的是NCS模型的基本版本，即具有两个类别且没有否决权的模型。其参数为充分准则联盟的集合以及区分两个类别的轮廓。关于充分联盟，我们提出了几种提问算法，这些算法将问题嫁接在经典的图探索方法之上。
tldr: 本文针对经过公理化刻画的非补偿性分类模型（NCS），提出了严格的直接参数引出程序，并设计了多种基于经典图探索方法的提问算法，用于确定充分准则联盟集合以及区分两个类别的轮廓参数。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a rigorous direct elicitation procedure for the parameters of the axiomatically characterized Non-Compensatory Sorting (NCS) model, proposing several questioning algorithms rooted in classical graph exploration to determine the set of sufficient coalitions and the profile separating the two categories.
